# MCP reference

What `netherite mcp` (stdio) and `/mcp` on a running `netherite serve` (streamable HTTP) offer an agent. Every write returns the new `hash`; pass it back as `baseHash` and the write fails if the file changed in between.

## Tools

### `search`

Full-text search over IDs, titles, aliases, paths and text. Returns matching items, best first.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string | yes |  |
| `types` | `goal` \| `project` \| `task` \| `adr` \| `doc` \| `context` \| `runbook`[] |  | Only these item types. |
| `status` | string |  | Only items with this status (goals, projects, ADRs) or state (tasks). |
| `project` | string |  | Only items that belong to this project. |
| `tag` | string |  | Only items with this tag or label. |
| `limit` | integer |  |  |

### `get`

One item in full: its fields, text, links in both directions, progress, freshness and content hash.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Item ID, such as TASK-00042. |
| `as_of` | string |  | A date (2026-03-01): show the state as it stood then, rebuilt from git history. Needs git. |

### `list`

Items matching filters, in ID order. Use it to browse; use `search` to find by text.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `goal` \| `project` \| `task` \| `adr` \| `doc` \| `context` \| `runbook` |  |  |
| `status` | string |  | Only items with this status (goals, projects, ADRs) or state (tasks). |
| `project` | string |  | Only items that belong to this project. |
| `tag` | string |  | Only items with this tag or label. |
| `limit` | integer |  |  |
| `offset` | integer |  |  |
| `as_of` | string |  | A date (2026-03-01): show the state as it stood then, rebuilt from git history. Needs git. |

### `create`

Create an item with the next free ID. Give its type, title and fields; the file name, ID, dates and folder are handled for you.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `goal` \| `project` \| `task` \| `adr` \| `doc` \| `context` \| `runbook` | yes |  |
| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `fields` | object |  | Fields for the type (see the schema resource for each type). |
| `body` | string |  | Text after the title heading, as Markdown. [[ID]] links to other items. |
| `created_by` | string |  | A @handle. Defaults to the person running the server. |

### `update`

Change fields and/or one section of an item. Only the lines you change are touched. Use `set_state` for states and `link` for relationships.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Item ID. |
| `set` | object |  | Fields to set. `id` and `type` cannot be changed. |
| `unset` | string[] |  | Fields to remove. |
| `section` | object |  |  |
| `base_hash` | string |  | The `hash` from an earlier result. The write fails if the file changed since. |

### `set_state`

Set a task's state, or an ADR's status. Making an ADR `superseded` needs `superseded_by` and updates both ADRs.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Task or ADR ID. |
| `state` | string | yes | Task states: backlog, doing, blocked, done. ADR statuses: proposed, accepted, deprecated, superseded. |
| `superseded_by` | string |  | The ADR that replaces this one. Required when state is superseded. |
| `base_hash` | string |  | The `hash` from an earlier result. The write fails if the file changed since. |

### `toggle_check`

Tick or untick one checklist item in an item's text.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Item ID. |
| `item` | any | yes | The 0-based position of the checklist item, or its exact text. |
| `checked` | boolean |  | Set to this state. Omit to flip it. |
| `base_hash` | string |  | The `hash` from an earlier result. The write fails if the file changed since. |

### `link`

Add a typed relationship from one item to another by ID. `supersedes` updates both ADRs.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | string | yes | The item that holds the relationship. |
| `to` | string | yes | The item it points at. |
| `kind` | `belongs_to` \| `implements` \| `explains` \| `supersedes` \| `depends_on` \| `related` | yes |  |
| `base_hash` | string |  | The `hash` from an earlier result. The write fails if the file changed since. |

### `unlink`

Remove a typed relationship. Required ones, such as a task's project, cannot be removed.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | string | yes | The item that holds the relationship. |
| `to` | string | yes | The item it points at. |
| `kind` | `belongs_to` \| `implements` \| `explains` \| `supersedes` \| `depends_on` \| `related` | yes |  |
| `base_hash` | string |  | The `hash` from an earlier result. The write fails if the file changed since. |

### `delete`

Delete an item. Refused while other items link to it, unless `force` is true.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Item ID. |
| `force` | boolean |  |  |
| `base_hash` | string |  | The `hash` from an earlier result. The write fails if the file changed since. |

### `mark_reviewed`

Record that a doc, runbook or context item was reviewed, by setting `reviewed_at`. Defaults to today.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Doc, runbook or context ID. |
| `date` | string |  |  |
| `base_hash` | string |  | The `hash` from an earlier result. The write fails if the file changed since. |

### `lint`

Check one item, or the whole workspace, for schema errors, broken links, duplicate IDs, stale docs and more. Each problem has a position, rule and severity.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string |  | Only report on this item. Omit for the whole workspace. |

### `context`

The curated context for agents: context items marked for inclusion, highest priority first, within the token budget.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | string |  | Only context for this project (and context not tied to one). |

## Resources

| URI | What |
| --- | --- |
| `netherite://context` | Curated context for agents, within the token budget. |
| `netherite://item/{id}` | The raw Markdown file of an item, by ID. |
| `netherite://schema/{type}` | JSON Schema for an item type. |

The schema of each item type is read at `netherite://schema/<type>` (goal, project, task, adr, doc, context, runbook); see the [schema reference](schemas.md).
